messages:
Alex C: Quick async shiproom for Q2 OKR milestones — dropping current statuses, owners, and blockers. Please update inline. TL;DR: runtime-v3 canary slipped, dedicated-autoscaler on track, optimize-evals needs triage.

Maya P: Thanks Alex. I'll own the runtime-v3 rollback plan. ETA EOD tomorrow. Blocker: can't repro perf regression locally; likely kv-cache change. @Sanjay R can you grab logs from the canary cluster?

Sanjay R: on it. I've pulled traces — looks like spike at step 3 of tokenization. Posting snippet:
```
TRACE: node-37: kv_cache_miss_rate=0.12
LATENCY p50=24ms p95=512ms
```
I'll add more in the ticket.

Priya S: Dedicated autoscaler: autoscale rule merged, smoke tests passed, putting canary in prod tomorrow AM. Owners: Priya (lead), Kelly (validation). :rocket:

Kelly M: Validation plan: run perf harness at seq_len=1024, 1k concurrent users. Quick ask — can someone merge my CR for the perf harness env var? @Alex C

Alex C: Merged. Also adding fallback policy for model-variant in case autoscaler overshoots. Patch: `fallback_prio = [gb_small, gb_medium, gb_large]`

Priya S: Note — billing tag for dedicated reserved pools needs update before canary. @Finance FYI (cc: Kelly M)

deploy-bot: deploy started: autoscaler-canary v2 -> prod.us-east-1 (link: https://deploys/redwood/176850)

Maya P: optimize-evals: we detected eval regression vs baseline on generation quality. Owner needed for prompt/regression triage. Suggest pairing eng+product: Maya + Kelly. Next step: gather 20 failing examples and run A/B with quantized model.

Alex C: Next actions:
- @Maya P gather failing examples by EOD Tue
- @Sanjay R chase the kv-cache trace and open hotfix PR
- @Priya S validate autoscaler canary tomorrow and confirm billing tag
- @Kelly M finish perf-harness CR + run validation
I'll compile a short update for the OKR doc after everyone's updates. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Priya S: acked. I'll post results in this thread post-canary.
